hints.title: Block Length Factorization
hints.text: Notice that every run of length at least 3 can be partitioned into smaller blocks of lengths 3, 4, and 5.

hints.title: Suffix State Formulation
hints.text: Let dp[i] represent the minimum cost to form a valid caption suffix starting at index i.

hints.title: Lexicographical Tie-Breaking
hints.text: For each block length in 3, 4, and 5 and character from a to z, transition from i + L and compare candidate suffixes lexicographically on equal costs.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates 3 block lengths across 26 lowercase characters per index in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy assignment fails because small local changes prevent downstream block grouping constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear storage tracks parent pointers and optimal lengths for suffix reconstruction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes runs of length at least 3 into base blocks of size 3, 4, and 5 with DP.
